besluite.rede: 'laat uitvoer' is more abstract and bookish for a Grade 5 reader and does not fit 'tempels en piramides'; the light repetition of 'bou' does not make the original fall short.
'gawes aan die gode' is the natural, idiomatic phrase for offerings in a religious context, so swapping it for 'geskenke' is a lateral move that also loses the offering sense.
Leaving out 'dat' after 'dink' is standard written Afrikaans and reads well, so the proposal is only a different form and makes the sentence longer.

The original says people in each group lived differently and can carry both senses (between groups and within them), so the proposal narrows the meaning to one of them and makes the subject more abstract.
